description: Read the Pinterest product CATALOG side of the connected account — what a Shopping (CATALOG_SALES) campaign serves from. what: catalogs (default), feeds, feed (feedId), processing_results (feedId — did Pinterest ingest the feed, product counts, errors), item_issues (processingResultId — per-product problems), product_groups (optionally feedId / catalogId), product_counts or products (productGroupId), items_batch (batchId). Pinterest catalogs need a BUSINESS account with a claimed website. Read-only, 0 credits.

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected

adAccountId.description: optional — act as this ad account’s owner via Pinterest Business Access (must be shared with this profile)

batchId.description: batch id returned by update_pinterest_catalog_items, used with items_batch

catalogId.description: catalog id from what:catalogs, used with feeds and product groups

feedId.description: feed id from what:feeds, used with feed, processing_results and product_groups

processingResultId.description: processing result id from what:processing_results, used with item_issues

productGroupId.description: product group id from what:product_groups, used with products and product_counts

what.description: which view to read; default catalogs

name: list_pinterest_catalogs
title: Read the Pinterest product catalog
